title: Orofacial Myofunctional Therapy Dataset for Obstructive Sleep Apnea
description: This dataset supports the study "Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Telemedicine for Orofacial Myofunctional Therapy in Sleep Apnea: Adult Patient Outcomes". It contains anonymised clinical and treatment-response data from 87 adult patients who underwent AI-assisted Orofacial Myofunctional Therapy (OMT) using the Smart Therapy Manager® system, aimed at treating Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) and Primary Snoring (PS). The data are provided in CSV, XLSX, TTL, XML and JSON formats and are intended for clinical research, machine-learning, sleep-medicine and treatment-outcome analysis.
